s: Which of the following was not included in the structure of the Community Development Program?
Which committee of UNSC designated Pakistan-based Jaish-e-Mohammad Chief Masood Azhar as a global terrorist?
x: The UNSC 1267 Committee handles the sanctions regime on Al-Qaida, Taliban and ISIL and associates (asset freeze, travel ban, arms embargo), which is the regime under which Masood Azhar was listed. The 1540 and 1373 committees deal with WMD non-proliferation and general counter-terrorism obligations, not individual listings.
